description: Source code for TransportConnectJob class handling network socket connections, including DNS resolution, IPv4/IPv6 connection attempts, and fallback logic within Chromium's networking stack.

classes.name: TransportSocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for socket transport, including destination endpoint, DNS policies, and supported ALPN protocols.

classes.name: TransportConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of establishing a network connection, including DNS resolution, IPv4/IPv6 connection attempts, and fallback handling.

classes.name: TransportConnectJob::EndpointResultOverride
classes.description: Overrides endpoint results for testing or special cases, including DNS aliases.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::ConnectionTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for connection attempts.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop handling different connection states and transitions.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::DoResolveHost
methods.description: Initiates DNS resolution for the destination host.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::DoResolveHostComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of DNS resolution, processes results, and invokes callbacks.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::DoTransportConnect
methods.description: Starts IPv4 and IPv6 connection attempts based on DNS results.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::DoTransportConnectComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of connection attempts, manages fallback if needed.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::HandleSubJobComplete
methods.description: Processes the result of a sub-connection attempt.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::OnSubJobComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when a sub-connection attempt completes.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::StartIPv4JobAsync
methods.description: Starts IPv4 connection asynchronously as a fallback.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::ChangePriorityInternal
methods.description: Updates the priority of the DNS request.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::IsSvcbOptional
methods.description: Determines if SVCB/HTTPS resolution can be considered optional based on context.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::IsEndpointResultUsable
methods.description: Checks if a DNS endpoint result is usable based on ALPN protocols and other criteria.
